title: Width of padded clauses
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $F$ be a conjunctive normal form on $n$ variables whose clauses each have width at most $3$. Every clause in the exactly-three-literal conversion of $F$ to a formula on $n+3$ variables has width exactly $3$.
